mode.title: Analysis Mode
mode.description: Choose whether to analyze a single project or scan an entire hackathon.

projectUrl.title: Project URL
projectUrl.description: URL of a single project submission (Devfolio or Devpost). Required when mode is 'single_project'.

hackathonUrl.title: Hackathon URL
hackathonUrl.description: URL of the hackathon page to scan all projects (Devfolio or Devpost). Required when mode is 'hackathon_scan'.

hackathonStartDate.title: Hackathon Start Date
hackathonStartDate.description: The official start date of the hackathon (YYYY-MM-DD). Used to verify GitHub commits and video upload dates.

hackathonEndDate.title: Hackathon End Date
hackathonEndDate.description: The official end date of the hackathon (YYYY-MM-DD). Used to verify commit timelines.

githubToken.title: GitHub Token (Optional)
githubToken.description: Personal access token for GitHub API. Increases rate limits from 60 to 5000 requests/hour. Leave empty for public access.

maxProjectsToScan.title: Max Projects to Scan
maxProjectsToScan.description: Maximum number of projects to analyze in hackathon scan mode. Set to 0 for unlimited.

deepAnalysis.title: Enable Deep Analysis
deepAnalysis.description: Performs thorough analysis including team member history, past hackathon participation, and code similarity checks. Takes longer but more accurate.

checkGitHubCommits.title: Check GitHub Commits
checkGitHubCommits.description: Analyze GitHub commit timestamps against hackathon dates.

checkTeamHistory.title: Check Team History
checkTeamHistory.description: Search for team members' past hackathon submissions to detect project reuse.

checkVideoTimestamps.title: Check Video Timestamps
checkVideoTimestamps.description: Verify video upload dates on YouTube/Loom against hackathon dates.

suspicionThreshold.title: Suspicion Score Threshold
suspicionThreshold.description: Minimum suspicion score (0-100) to flag a project. Projects below this score are marked as 'likely clean'.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum HTTP requests the crawler can make. Higher values allow more thorough analysis.
